summary: Depots where the vehicle may end (alternative to end_index).
range: Array of depot id strings; each must match a defined depot.
businessRules: Delivery-type jobs with depots configured cannot be served by a vehicle that has only end depots.

end_depot_ids defines: Specify the depots where the vehicle should end its trip. It is assumed that the vehicles will unload the goods, which were picked-up during the trip, upon arriving the given depot. If certain pick…
Each element in end_depot_ids must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.end_index, jobs.depot_ids. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: relocation shift starting at depot A, ending at depot B.
Interaction: Positive: two depots north/south, demand split by region -> each vehicle serves its nearby cluster.
Interaction: Infeasible: job depot_ids incompatible with any vehicle's depots -> unassigned.
